integrity: The proof gives an explicit complement decomposition from the semidirect-product coordinates, derives the cyclic-subgroup graph as a one-point union, and then compares exact edge formulas. The packaged replay reconstructs the groups and all cyclic-subgroup cover relations from multiplication for six admissible examples.
scientific_limitations: The Frobenius kernel has prime order.
The complement is cyclic, faithful, even, and has order at least four.
The result proves the edge-minimality conjecture only for this infinite family of even-order groups.
The complement-of-order-two dihedral boundary is excluded from the originality claim.
title: Cyclic-subgroup graphs of prime-kernel Frobenius groups with even cyclic complement
